decisions.reason: The Air Quality Bricklet is a current-generation module in the building-block system and fits ongoing demand for indoor air monitoring, so keeping it costs little and supports the platform.
The Analog In Bricklet 3.0 is the latest generation of a core measurement module that replaced its predecessor, so it is likely to stay in the range.
The CAN bus interface serves industrial and automation customers and extends the platform's connectivity options, which matches the firm's direction.
The CO2 sensor module has its own product page and fits the strong interest in air quality and ventilation monitoring, so it is worth keeping.
